Definition
[Notation: gradient matrix $D\mathbf f$] ↗ def:vector-valued-function-notation 1. appC:C.5-def-1\group Inverse and Implicit Function Theorems

The gradient matrix is \[ D\mathbf f= \begin{pmatrix} f^1_{x_1} & \cdots & f^1_{x_n} \\ \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\ f^n_{x_1} & \cdots & f^n_{x_n} \end{pmatrix}_{n\times n}. \]
